questions.q: What does Brené Brown say about courage and vulnerability?
a: They always go together, and vulnerability is a sign of strength
They are opposites, since courage means hiding all weakness
Vulnerability matters only in private, never at work
Courage can be learned without ever feeling uncertain
questions.why: Lesson 1 argues that choosing courage always means accepting risk and uncertainty.

questions.q: How many core values should you focus on, according to lesson 2?
a: Two
Three
Five
Ten
questions.why: Lesson 2 recommends narrowing your values to just two so they can actually guide you.

questions.q: Why does focusing on too many values weaken them?
a: If everything matters, then nothing gets prioritized
Most values contradict each other by definition
Values only work when kept secret from others
Lists longer than two items are impossible to memorize
questions.why: Lesson 2 says claiming all values matter leads to prioritizing none of them.

questions.q: What does the "V" in BRAVING stand for?
a: Vault-closing, meaning you protect each other's confidences
Vision, meaning you set a clear direction for the team
Voice, meaning everyone gets equal time to speak
Velocity, meaning decisions are made quickly
questions.why: Lesson 3 lists vault-closing as keeping confidential information safe.

questions.q: According to the BRAVING list, what should replace judgment?
a: Curiosity
Silence
Competition
Certainty
questions.why: Lesson 3 says replacing judgment with curiosity turns isolation into connection.
